title: magnolia aenea
intro: Magnolia aenea, commonly known as the Yellow Poplar tree or Yellow Birch, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the Magnoliaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Magnolia aenea include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and other conditions due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Magnolia aenea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
